gap: No result ChatGPT got works out how many December days a kit's own panel needs to refill its battery. Using SolutionEnergy's figure of 2 kWh per kW of panels on a December day, the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W kit ($1,199) needs 5.2 sunny days to refill, so its panel cannot top it up within a weekend. The ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP037 400 W kit ($948) needs 2.4 days, supplies about 3,330 Wh over a two-day December weekend and has the lowest cost per usable Wh of the kits checked ($0.55).
standout_why: Compared against the three pages ChatGPT cited. solutionenergy.com/off-grid/cabins gives weekend storage of 2.5–3 kWh and '2 kWh per kW on a December day', but no refill hours, no product prices and no kit math. ankersolix.com's setup guide gives runtime as capacity × 0.9 ÷ daily Wh and solar as daily Wh ÷ PSH ÷ 0.85 for Anker stations, with no prices and no refill time. ankersolix.com's essentials checklist says a 400 W array gives 1,200–2,000 Wh a day, again with no prices or refill time. Our own current page gives summer daily yield per panel but no refill days, no December figure and no cost per usable Wh, and some of its prices are now stale. Neither ChatGPT answer gives refill time or $/usable Wh.
decides: The panel bundled with a kit decides the pick more than the battery size does. A single 200 W panel on a 2 kWh station refills it only every 2.4 summer days or 5.2 December days, so for a weekend the battery has to carry nearly all the load. With 400 W, a kit adds about 1.6 kWh over a December weekend. That moves the pick to a 2 kWh-class station with 400 W of panels: the ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP037 at $948 if it can be confirmed in stock, or the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 2× 200 W at $1,499. It moves away from the Elite 200 V2 + 350 W, which now costs $1,449 and ships from Dec 25, and from the Elite 200 V2 + 200 W. The AC180 + 200 W ($769) supplies about 1.8 kWh over a December weekend, which covers SolutionEnergy's 2 kWh weekend load on that page's numbers. It falls well short of ChatGPT's 2,270 Wh fridge example.
